jobs.title: Channel Sales Manager - East
jobs.description:
Build a safer world with us, one incident at a time.

Ambient.ai is the category creator and leader in Agentic Physical Security. Powered by Ambient Pulsar, the first reasoning Vision-Language Model purpose-built for physical security, our platform seamlessly integrates with existing security cameras and physical access control systems to unify monitoring, access control, threat assessment, response, and investigations through an always-on reasoning layer that augments security operators with superhuman capabilities. The results: 95% fewer false alarms, investigations 20x faster, and 10x faster response.

The momentum speaks for itself: we doubled new ARR in FY26, and have delivered results for world-class customers including Cisco, ServiceNow, SentinelOne, TikTok, Bayer, and MoMA. That kind of momentum creates an environment where great people thrive, and it shows: we recently ranked #71 out of 500 on the Forbes best startup employers list https://www.forbes.com/lists/americas-best-startup-employers/.

Founded in 2017 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, and Allegion Ventures, Ambient.ai is on a fast-paced journey to fulfill our mission: prevent every security incident possible.

Ready to learn more? Connect with us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/ambient-ai/?viewAsMember=true and  YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@ambient-ai-inc

About the role:

Reporting directly to Colby Mulry https://www.linkedin.com/in/colbymulry/, Director of Channel Sales, we are looking for a driven and relationship-focused Channel Manager to join our growing partnerships team at Ambient.ai. In this role, you will own the day-to-day execution of our channel partner program - building and nurturing relationships with resellers, distributors, and VAR partners to expand Ambient’s reach in the physical security market. You’re someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, knows how to get things done through partners, and brings a genuine passion for building win-win relationships.

What you’ll do:

 - Manage and grow relationships with a defined set of channel partners, distributors, and VAR resellers - serving as their primary point of contact at Ambient.ai

 - Identify and onboard new partners that align with our go-to-market strategy, supporting the expansion of our channel network

 - Work cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and product teams to support partner-led opportunities, joint campaigns, and product launches

 - Track and report on partner performance metrics, pipeline activity, and KPIs - using data to surface insights and flag areas for improvement

What you’ll bring:

 - 3-5 years of channel sales or channel management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS or security technology

 - Hands-on experience working with Security and/or IT VAR reseller partners

 - Strong understanding of channel sales motions, partner enablement, and co-selling best practices

 - Proven ability to manage a book of partners, hit revenue targets, and drive consistent pipeline through the channel

 - Excellent communicator and relationship builder - you know how to work with partners and internal stakeholders alike

Why join us:

 - We are creating an entirely new category within a 120+ billion-dollar physical security industry, and we’re looking for team members who share our mission to prevent every security incident possible

 - We have an impressive customer roster of F500 companies, including Adobe, TikTok, and SentinelOne

 - Regular full-time employees receive stock options for the opportunity to share in the success of our company

 - Comprehensive health + welfare package (Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, EAP, Legal Services, 401k plan)

 - We offer flexible time off to rest and recharge, including Winter Break (time off between Christmas and New Year’s for most roles depending on customer demand)

 - The latest tech and awesome swag will be delivered to your door

 - Enjoy a full range of opportunities to connect with your awesome co-workers

 - We love to hike https://www.alltrails.com/us/california/redwood-city, are foodies, and love music! Check out our most recent Ambient Spotify Playlist https://open.spotify.com/playlist/2kx8dM5h65Tac5UOo0kuWr?si=cebFZmkHQhKEvnoall2rcQ

About the role:

As a Regional Sales Manager, Strategic Accounts, you'll own the full sales strategy and execution for a defined territory, driving both new customer acquisition and expansion revenue. This is a full-cycle, quota-carrying role built for someone who's comfortable navigating complex enterprise deals with multiple stakeholders - from security operations leaders to C-suite executives - and who wants to help define what enterprise sales looks like in a brand-new product category.

You'll be building your book of business largely from scratch in a market Ambient.ai is actively creating, which means the role rewards strategic territory planning and creative pipeline generation as much as it does deal execution. You'll work closely with Sales Engineering, so you're never building a business case alone.

What you'll do:

 - You will take ownership of an assigned territory focused on net new logo and upsell opportunities

 - You will demonstrate expertise in building business cases that clearly show value and differentiation at all levels of your customer organizations including C-level executives

 - You will constantly generate pipeline using creative techniques, tools, team collaboration, industry events, and top-tier channel partners

 - You will close deals through world-class planning and preparation, developing and cultivating relationships with enterprise organizations, as well as being consultative in your approach to solving complex real business problems

 - You will demonstrate expertise in building business cases that clearly show value and differentiation at all levels of your customer/prospect organizations

 - You will benefit from complementary and robust Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, Value Consulting, and Transformation Teams throughout your sales cycles

 - You will win deals through world-class planning and preparation, as well as being consultative in your approach to solving real business problems

What you'll bring:

 - 5+ years of experience evangelizing enterprise technology, with a focus on SaaS and disruptive cloud technologies

 - Consistent track record of over-achievement; net new logo accomplishments; and keen understanding of how to leverage partner relationships

 - You have significant experience with MEDDIC as a leading indicator driven sales process (highly preferred)

 - You demonstrate a true “value-based” sales approach and have experience explaining complex ROI models to C-level customers

 - You’re ready to think differently, learn, and embrace new methodologies

 - You’re a natural champion builder and go the extra mile to add real value

 - You’re an entrepreneur - you run your patch like a business

 - You don’t cut corners, even with SFDC hygiene

 - A track record of overachievement and hitting sales targets

 - Driven and competitive: Possesses a strong desire to be successful

Why join us:

 - We are creating an entirely new category within a 180+ billion-dollar physical security industry and looking for team members who are also passionate about our mission to prevent every security incident possible 

 - We have an impressive customer roster of F500 companies including Adobe, VMware, and SentinelOne

 - Regular Full-time employees receive stock options for the opportunity to share ownership in the success of our company 

 - Comprehensive health + welfare package (Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, EAP, Legal Services, 401k plan)

 - We offer flexible time off to rest and recharge including Winter Break (time off between Christmas and New Year’s for most roles depending on customer demand)

 - The latest tech and awesome swag delivered to your door

 - Enjoy a full range of opportunities to connect with your awesome co-workers

About The Role: 

As our Workplace & People Operations Coordinator, you’ll be a key operator behind the scenes at Ambient—helping run our Redwood City office and creating an environment where employees can do their best work, candidates have exceptional experiences, and our leadership team can move quickly.

This is a great entry-level opportunity to break into the Bay Area tech and startup ecosystem. You don't need years of experience or a traditional tech background—we're looking for someone who is curious, highly organized, eager to learn, and excited to be part of a fast-moving company. You'll gain hands-on exposure to how a growing technology company operates while working across workplace operations, recruiting, people coordination, executive support, and special projects.

You'll work closely with People, Recruiting, Finance, IT, and company leadership, while serving as a trusted point of contact for employees, candidates, customers, and visitors. It's a role where you'll learn quickly, take on increasing responsibility, and build a strong foundation for a career in tech.

What you will do:

Workplace & Office Operations

 - Own the workplace experience: Keep our Redwood City office organized, welcoming, and always client-ready. Greet candidates, customers, and guests with warmth and professionalism.

 - Create an exceptional Day 1: Own new hire onboarding from start to finish, including equipment, desk setup, access, and swag, so every new employee feels welcome and ready to contribute.

 - Build culture through experiences: Plan company events and celebrations, manage company swag, and lead the Anniversary Recognition Program.

 - Manage vendors, budgets, and safety: Oversee office vendors and expenses with Finance to find savings. Own workplace safety, compliance, and security, including badge access.

 - Keep the company moving: Run Friday company meetings, coordinate in-office replica weapon testing, and take on other priorities as they come up.

Recruiting & Candidate Experience

 - Own interview logistics: Schedule interviews across candidates, interviewers, and time zones in Ashby, and keep schedules and candidate status accurate so the recruiting team can trust the data.

 - Create an exceptional candidate experience: Keep candidates informed and prepared at every step. Welcome onsite interviewees and run onsite interview days smoothly, from rooms and meals to fixing issues as they come up.

 - Drive follow-through: Make sure interviewers submit scorecards on time, and help hiring managers schedule and coordinate debriefs.

 - Support recruiting initiatives: Help with career fairs, campus recruiting and other events that build our talent pipeline.

Executive & Leadership Support

 - Travel & Logistics: Plan travel from start to finish. This covers flights, hotels, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for customer meetings and other business trips.

 - Expense Management: Work with Finance to keep executive Ramp expenses and reports accurate and submitted on time.

 - Offsites & Events: Make leadership and team offsites, dinners and gatherings run smoothly, from choosing the venue and catering to preparing materials and handling day-of logistics.

 - Strategic Partner to Leadership: Be a flexible partner to the leadership team. Coordinate meetings, handle ad-hoc requests, and drive high-priority projects such as building presentations, researching vendors and solving whatever operational challenge comes up.

What you will bring:

 - 1-3 years of experience in workplace operations, office management, executive support, recruiting coordination, or a similar operations role. Early-career candidates with strong organizational skills and relevant internship or administrative experience are encouraged to apply.

 - Location: this is a fully in-office role, 5 days per week (Monday–Friday) at our Redwood City office. You must be able to commute to Redwood City daily; remote and hybrid arrangements are not available.

 - Exceptional organization and attention to detail. You can manage competing priorities across the office, recruiting, and executive support without losing track of the details.

 - Strong judgment and ownership. You don't wait to be told what needs to happen—you notice gaps, ask questions, and follow things through to completion.

 - Warm, polished, and professional. You enjoy being a trusted point of contact for candidates, employees, customers, executives, and other guests.

 - Highly resourceful and adaptable. You're comfortable switching between different types of work and can stay calm when plans change.

 - Tech-savvy and eager to learn. You're comfortable with Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets (including basic formulas) and Google Slides, and are willing to learn and troubleshoot common workplace technology such as Zoom Rooms.

 - Comfortable managing vendors and budgets and keeping track of expenses.

 - Demonstrated AI fluency. You're comfortable using AI tools daily to research, draft, organize, problem-solve, and streamline everyday work.

 - Bonus: Experience with Ashby or another applicant tracking system.

 - Bonus: Familiarity with OSHA and workplace safety requirements.

Why Join Us

 - We are creating an entirely new category, Agentic Physical Security, within a 180+ billion-dollar physical security industry.

 - Regular full-time employees receive stock options and a comprehensive health + welfare package (Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, EAP, Legal Services, 401k).

 - Flexible time off, including Winter Break between Christmas and New Year's for most roles.
